journal_lines: Tall thing in the dark. Careful not to look directly.
Purple eyes in the dark. Pearl for it.
Tall as the doorway. Did not fit through it. Did not need to.
It held a block of dirt the way you hold a memory.
Looked once. It looked back. There are rules about this.
Purple sound in the air. Like someone unstitching somewhere.
Was over here. Was over there. Was nowhere worth describing for a moment.
Tall and quiet and reasonable, until it was not.
Where it stood, the grass was bent flat. Where it went, the grass remembered.
Caught the pearl as it fell. Warm. Heavier than expected.
